one_line: Master sthapati and chief builder-architect of Khajuraho’s great temples, embodying the sacred craft lineage of 10th–11th century central India.

appearance.age_look: Looks mid-30s to early 40s, lean but sturdy artisan’s build with defined forearms and shoulders.
appearance.face: Oval face with a straight nose, medium-full lips, warm medium-brown complexion, faint smile-lines at the eyes, neatly trimmed short moustache, calm focused gaze; default expression is serene concentration with a hint of quiet pride.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair gathered into a low, compact knot at the back of the head (like a modest artisan’s chignon), with a narrow white cotton headband wrapped once around the forehead, knot tucked at the back; a few short side strands frame the temples.
appearance.costume: Wears a long, modest, knee-length off-white cotton tunic with three-quarter sleeves and a simple round neck, belted at the waist with a narrow reddish-brown woven cloth sash; over this, a soft pale-cream angavastra-style shawl with a muted mustard border is draped from the left shoulder across the torso and under the right arm for ease of movement; lower garment is a deep-earthy-ochre cotton dhoti, pleated and wrapped securely to the ankles, with a simple flat front and a narrow border in dull maroon; feet in plain brown leather sandals with a toe strap; minimal jewellery: a single thin copper armlet on the right upper arm and a simple black-thread necklace with a small, round copper pendant tucked modestly against the chest.
appearance.signature: A well-used wooden measuring rod etched with faint grid marks and a tied bundle of slender iron chisels hanging from his sash, the rod usually held in his right hand like a staff.

ref_desc: Chhichha is a lean, medium-brown man in his late 30s with an oval face, black hair in a low knot with a white headband, wearing an off-white tunic, pale-cream shawl, earthy-ochre ankle-length dhoti, brown sandals, simple copper ornaments, and carrying a wooden measuring rod and bundled iron chisels in warm ochre and reddish-brown tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Chhichha, a dignified 11th-century Indian master builder from Khajuraho: a lean, medium-brown man in his late 30s with an oval face, calm focused eyes, short moustache, and thick black hair tied in a low knot at the back, wrapped with a narrow white cotton headband and a few short strands at the temples; he wears a modest off-white knee-length cotton tunic with three-quarter sleeves and a simple round neck, belted with a narrow reddish-brown woven cloth sash, and a pale-cream angavastra-style shawl with a muted mustard border draped from his left shoulder across the torso and under the right arm; his lower garment is a deep earthy-ochre cotton dhoti wrapped and pleated neatly to the ankles with a dull maroon border, and his feet are in plain brown leather sandals; minimal jewellery includes a single thin copper armlet on the right upper arm and a simple black-thread necklace with a small round copper pendant resting against his chest; his signature tools are a well-used wooden measuring rod etched with faint grid marks held in his right hand like a staff and a tied bundle of slender iron chisels hanging from his waist sash; present him in warm, earthy tones (off-white, earthy ochre, reddish brown, mustard, brown leather) with front, side, and back views, keeping the clothing modest and historically grounded, and emphasizing the consistent hairstyle, headband, garments, and tools.
